title: Jazzy Cheesy Algerian Lentils Tagine
description: A garlicky, cheese-pull crowd-pleaser Algerian tagine that pairs hearty lentils with dashi extract for depth, topped with a melty cheese blend and made egg-free.

ingredients.name: spice mix
ingredients.notes: cumin 1/2 tsp, coriander 1/2 tsp, paprika 1/2 tsp, cinnamon 1/4 tsp, salt 1/4 tsp, pepper 1/4 tsp

instructions: Rinse lentils under cold water until water runs clear.
In a tagine or deep pot, heat 2 tbsp olive oil over medium heat and sauté onions, carrots, and garlic until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and dashi extract, cooking for 2 minutes to release flavors.
Add lentils, vegetable broth, and spice mix, bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and cover, simmering until lentils are tender, about 25 minutes.
Once lentils are cooked, stir in shredded cheddar and mozzarella cheese until melted and well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a shallow oven-safe dish, top with a drizzle of olive oil, and bake at 350°F (175°C) until the cheese forms a golden crust, about 10 minutes.
Remove from oven and let rest for 5 minutes to set the cheese pull.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs like parsley if desired.
Enjoy your jazzy cheesy Algerian lentils tagine, egg-free perfect for a crowd.
